settings.doc: Top-level keys of the scene file that are plain render settings. Any string "$name" anywhere in the file is replaced by the value of "variables"[name]. Colours are [r, g, b] or one of the names black, white, red, green, blue. Integers may be written as whole floats.

fields.name: width
fields.doc: Image width in pixels (--width overrides).

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Image height in pixels (--height overrides).

fields.name: supersamples
fields.doc: Samples per pixel at least; rounded up to a multiple of samples_per_chunk squared.

fields.name: samples_per_chunk
fields.doc: Each pass over the image takes this squared samples per pixel.

fields.name: adaptive
fields.doc: Adaptive sampling: a noise threshold, true (0.01), or {"threshold": 0.01, "min_samples": 16}; absent, false or 0 for none.

fields.name: chunk_size
fields.doc: Side in pixels of the squares the image is rendered in.

fields.name: max_depth
fields.doc: Longest path, in bounces, before it is cut off.

fields.name: shadow_bias
fields.doc: Distance scattered and shadow rays start off the surface, in scene units.

fields.name: black_threshold
fields.doc: Paths whose throughput falls to this or below are dropped.

fields.name: path_termination
fields.doc: What ends a path: black at max_depth only, or Russian roulette as well.

fields.name: russian_roulette_depth
fields.doc: With russian_roulette: bounces before roulette starts.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Render seed: the same seed gives the same image (--seed overrides).

fields.name: sample_lights
fields.doc: Sample lights directly (next event estimation) rather than only by chance hits.

fields.name: sample_sky
fields.doc: Sample the sky (or other background light) directly, from a table of its brightness.

fields.name: light_sampler
fields.doc: How lights are chosen for direct sampling: by power, or by a light BVH (for many lights).

fields.name: integrator
fields.doc: The path tracer, or its wavefront form (paths traced in batches).

fields.name: sampler
fields.doc: The sequence sample points are drawn from.

fields.name: regularise
fields.doc: Least GGX roughness after a path's first scattering (path regularisation: softer caustics, less noise); 0 turns it off.

fields.name: spectral
fields.doc: Trace wavelengths rather than RGB, so glass with a varying refractive index disperses light.

fields.name: shutter
fields.doc: [open, close] in the time of motion: moving things are at their start at 0 and their "motion" pose at 1.

fields.name: filter
fields.doc: Pixel reconstruction filter; or an object {"type": name, "radius": pixels (gaussian 1.5, mitchell 2, lanczos 3), "sigma": 0.5, "b" and "c": 1/3, "tau": 3}.

fields.name: background
fields.doc: Seen where rays hit nothing: a colour, {"type": "gradient", "bottom": colour (default white), "top": colour (default [0.5, 0.7, 1])}, or {"type": "space", "seed", "brightness", "threshold", "sun_irradiance", "stars", "milky_way", "nebulae", "galaxies"} (see docs/space.md).

camera.doc: The camera (required): where it is and looks, and by "type" a thin-lens perspective camera, an orthographic or spherical one, or one that traces rays through a real lens.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: The kind of camera.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Position of the camera.

fields.name: lookat
fields.doc: Point looked at; its distance is the default focus distance.

fields.name: up
fields.doc: Up direction, usually [0, 1, 0].

fields.name: angle
fields.doc: Field of view in radians: the image's height spans tan(angle) at unit distance. Required for perspective, and for orthographic without "height".

fields.name: aperture
fields.doc: Perspective: lens radius in scene units, for depth of field; 0 for a pinhole.

fields.name: focus_distance
fields.doc: Perspective and realistic: distance in focus; default the distance to lookat.

fields.name: astigmatism
fields.doc: Perspective: an astigmatic lens; powers in reciprocal scene units.

fields.name: cylinder
fields.doc: Power of a cylinder added to the lens.

fields.name: axis
fields.doc: The cylinder's axis, degrees.

fields.name: seidel
fields.doc: Power of off-axis (Seidel) astigmatism, growing towards the image's corners.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Orthographic: height of the rectangle seen, scene units; default what the perspective camera sees at lookat.

fields.name: mapping
fields.doc: Spherical: how directions map to the image.

fields.name: lens
fields.doc: Realistic: dgauss.50mm, wide.22mm, telephoto.250mm, fisheye.10mm, or a pbrt lens .dat file; it sets the field of view.

fields.name: f_number
fields.doc: Realistic: the stop's f-number; default wide open.

fields.name: film_diagonal
fields.doc: Realistic: the film's diagonal, mm.

fields.name: blades
fields.doc: Realistic: blades of a polygonal stop; default a round one.

fields.name: blade_rotation
fields.doc: Realistic: rotation of the blades, degrees.

fields.name: motion
fields.doc: The pose the camera moves to while the shutter is open; each key defaults to the start's.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Position at the end.

fields.name: lookat
fields.doc: Point looked at at the end.

fields.name: up
fields.doc: Up direction at the end.

sun.doc: The directional sun light, sampled directly; absent or null for none. With a skysphere in objects it follows the sky's sun_direction, is reddened by its atmosphere, and its intensity sets the sky's brightness (the skysphere must then not give "brightness").

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: Direction towards the sun; required without a skysphere, not allowed with one.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Colour of the light.

fields.name: intensity
fields.doc: Irradiance on a surface facing the sun (above the atmosphere, with a skysphere).

fields.name: angular_radius
fields.doc: Radius of the sun's disc, degrees.

output.doc: How the linear image is finished and mapped for display. Glare, flare, the film keys (iso, exposure_time, white_balance, color_space) and saturation apply to every output; exposure, tonemap and transfer only to PNG.

fields.name: exposure
fields.doc: Multiplier on linear values before tone mapping.

fields.name: tonemap
fields.doc: Tone curve: none clips above 1, reinhard is v / (1 + v), filmic is the ACES fit.

fields.name: transfer
fields.doc: Display encoding.

fields.name: gamma
fields.doc: With transfer gamma: the exponent.

fields.name: saturation
fields.doc: Colour saturation: 0 grey, 1 unchanged.

fields.name: iso
fields.doc: Film speed: scales the image by iso / 100.

fields.name: exposure_time
fields.doc: Exposure time, s: scales the image.

fields.name: white_balance
fields.doc: Illuminant rendered as white: "D50", "D55", "D65", "D75", "A", or a colour temperature in kelvin; absent for none.

fields.name: color_space
fields.doc: Colour space of the output's primaries.

fields.name: glare
fields.doc: Camera glare (bloom) around bright pixels: true for defaults, or this object; absent or false: none.

fields.name: strength
fields.doc: Fraction of light spread into the glare.

fields.name: core
fields.doc: Angular size of the glare's core, degrees.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Angle the glare reaches, degrees.

fields.name: threshold
fields.doc: Only pixels brighter than this (after exposure) glare.

fields.name: flare
fields.doc: Lens flare from bright lights, traced through a lens: true for defaults, or this object; absent or false: none.

fields.name: lens
fields.doc: The lens, as the realistic camera's; default that camera's, else dgauss.50mm (wide.22mm for wide views).

fields.name: f_number
fields.doc: The stop; default the realistic camera's, else wide open.

fields.name: blades
fields.doc: Blades of the stop (they shape the starburst); default the realistic camera's, else round.

fields.name: blade_rotation
fields.doc: Rotation of the blades, degrees.

fields.name: blade_curvature
fields.doc: How curved the blades are: 1 rounds the open stop, 0 straight.

fields.name: imperfection
fields.doc: How far each blade is out of place; 0 for a perfect diaphragm.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Chooses the blades' imperfections.

fields.name: threshold
fields.doc: Only light sources brighter than this make flare.

fields.name: sources
fields.doc: Most light sources flared.

fields.name: ghosts
fields.doc: Scale of the ghosts (reflections between elements); 0 or false for none.

fields.name: starburst
fields.doc: Scale of the starburst (diffraction by the stop); 0 or false for none.

fields.name: grid
fields.doc: Rays across the lens for each ghost.

fields.name: coating
fields.doc: Anti-reflection coating of the elements.

light.doc: One entry of "lights": a light at a point, shining every way, or with one of "spot", "goniometric" or "projection" by direction.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Position of the light.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Colour of the light (or a name: white, red, ...); not with temperature.

fields.name: temperature
fields.doc: In place of color: a blackbody of this temperature, kelvin, scaled to unit luminance.

fields.name: intensity
fields.doc: Radiant intensity (per steradian); falls off with the square of distance. One of intensity and power is required.

fields.name: power
fields.doc: In place of intensity: the light's total power.

fields.name: spot
fields.doc: A spot light: a cone about a direction.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: Axis of the cone; one of direction and lookat is required.

fields.name: lookat
fields.doc: A point the cone is aimed at, in place of direction.

fields.name: angle
fields.doc: Half-angle of the cone, degrees.

fields.name: delta
fields.doc: The outer part of the angle over which the light fades, degrees.

fields.name: goniometric
fields.doc: Intensity scaled by an equirectangular image of directions.

fields.name: image
fields.doc: The image; its top row is up.

fields.name: up
fields.doc: The image's pole.

fields.name: forward
fields.doc: Direction of azimuth zero.

fields.name: projection
fields.doc: An image projected as by a slide projector.

fields.name: image
fields.doc: The image projected.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: Where it points; one of direction and lookat is required.

fields.name: lookat
fields.doc: A point it is aimed at, in place of direction.

fields.name: up
fields.doc: Up of the image.

fields.name: fov
fields.doc: Angle across the image's larger side, degrees.

air.doc: Accepted but ignored: parse_air always returns a vacuum whatever the value. Use a "fog" or "volume" object instead.

object_common.doc: Keys handled generically for objects. "material", "medium" and "normal" apply to geometry-backed objects, checkeredplane, planet, the rock objects, and (replacing their own shading, only if material or medium is given) ocean and grass; skysphere, box_terrain, landscape, firework, fog, volume, mountains and the cloud types ignore them. "transform", "inverse" and "clipped_by" apply to geometry-backed objects only. Applied in the order clipped_by, inverse, transform.

fields.name: material
fields.doc: Name of the surface's material; absent (and no medium): white lambertian. On a shape nested in a CSG or transform, makes that part keep its own material.

fields.name: medium
fields.doc: Name of a medium (a material that varies over the surface); takes precedence over material.

fields.name: normal
fields.doc: Bump mapping: tilts the shading normal by a pattern, or by a tangent-space normal map image ("map"), without changing the shape. Applies wherever material/medium do. Only an object is a bump map: a plane's or disc's own "normal" is a vector.

fields.name: pattern
fields.doc: The pattern of bumps; required unless "map" is given.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: How strongly the normal is tilted.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Size of the pattern: a number, or [x, y, z] to stretch it; never zero.

fields.name: octaves
fields.doc: wrinkles: layers of finer detail.

fields.name: frequency
fields.doc: ripples and waves: rings per unit of the pattern.

fields.name: phase
fields.doc: ripples and waves: shift of the rings, in cycles.

fields.name: map
fields.doc: A normal map image, read by the texture coordinates, in place of a pattern; "scale" is then its repeats (a number or [u, v]).

fields.name: strength
fields.doc: With map: how strongly the map tilts the normal.

fields.name: offset
fields.doc: With map: shift of the texture coordinates, a number or [u, v].

fields.name: filter
fields.doc: With map: how the image is filtered.

fields.name: wrap
fields.doc: With map: what lies beyond the image's edges.

fields.name: linear
fields.doc: With map: the image holds linear values (not sRGB).

fields.name: transform
fields.doc: List of transform steps (see transform_step), applied in order to the whole shape including its clipping, eg. [{"scale": 2}, {"rotate": [0, 45, 0]}, {"translate": [0, 1, 0]}]. Geometry-backed objects only (sphere, triangle, mesh, smoothmesh, box, plane, rotate, transform, CSG, terrain, the POV-Ray shapes, patches, curves, subdivision surfaces), at top level or nested; ignored by checkeredplane and by procedural objects.

fields.name: inverse
fields.doc: Turn the shape inside out (its outside becomes its inside, for CSG). Geometry-backed objects only (sphere, triangle, mesh, smoothmesh, box, plane, rotate, transform, CSG, terrain, the POV-Ray shapes, patches, curves, subdivision surfaces), at top level or nested; ignored by checkeredplane and by procedural objects.

fields.name: clipped_by
fields.doc: Keep only the part of the surface inside this shape (does not close the cut). Geometry-backed objects only (sphere, triangle, mesh, smoothmesh, box, plane, rotate, transform, CSG, terrain, the POV-Ray shapes, patches, curves, subdivision surfaces), at top level or nested; ignored by checkeredplane and by procedural objects.

transform_step.doc: One step of a "transform" list (or of a transform object's "steps"): an object with exactly one of these keys. Steps apply in list order.

fields.name: translate
fields.doc: Move by [x, y, z].

fields.name: rotate
fields.doc: [x, y, z] degrees about the x axis, then y, then z (right-hand rule); or {"roll", "pitch", "yaw"} naming the same angles.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: A number, or [x, y, z] factors, about the origin.

fields.name: axis_rotate
fields.doc: Rotate about any axis through the origin.

fields.name: axis
fields.doc: The axis; must not be zero.

fields.name: angle
fields.doc: Degrees, right-hand rule.

fields.name: matrix
fields.doc: 12 numbers in POV-Ray's order: the three rows of the linear part, then the translation.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Centre.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Radius.

fields.name: v0
fields.doc: First vertex.

fields.name: v1
fields.doc: Second vertex.

fields.name: v2
fields.doc: Third vertex.

box.label: Box
box.doc: An axis-aligned box between two corners.

fields.name: min
fields.doc: One corner.

fields.name: max
fields.doc: The opposite corner (either order).

plane.label: Plane
plane.doc: An infinite horizontal ground plane at height y; or, with normal and distance, POV-Ray's plane (the half-space n.p < distance, usable in CSG).

fields.name: y
fields.doc: Height of the horizontal plane (the form used when "normal" is absent).

fields.name: normal
fields.doc: In place of y: an [x, y, z] vector for POV-Ray's half-space n.p < distance, usable in CSG (an object here is a bump map instead).

fields.name: distance
fields.doc: Half-space form: distance of the plane from the origin along the normal.

checkeredplane.label: Checkered plane
checkeredplane.doc: A horizontal plane at height y with the object's material or medium (use a checkered-y-plane medium for the checks).

fields.name: y
fields.doc: Height of the plane.

cylinder.label: Cylinder
cylinder.doc: A cylinder between two end points, closed by flat ends unless open.

fields.name: base
fields.doc: Centre of one end.

fields.name: cap
fields.doc: Centre of the other end; must differ from base.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Radius.

fields.name: open
fields.doc: Leave the flat ends off.

cone.label: Cone
cone.doc: A truncated cone between two end points with a radius at each.

fields.name: base
fields.doc: Centre of the base end.

fields.name: base_radius
fields.doc: Radius at the base.

fields.name: cap
fields.doc: Centre of the cap end; must differ from base.

fields.name: cap_radius
fields.doc: Radius at the cap (0 for a point).

fields.name: open
fields.doc: Leave the flat ends off.

disc.label: Disc
disc.doc: A flat circular disc with an optional central hole.

fields.name: center
fields.doc: Centre of the disc.

fields.name: normal
fields.doc: Direction the disc faces (non-zero); clashes with the common bump-map "normal", so the disc must sit inside a transform or CSG item without its own material.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Outer radius.

fields.name: hole_radius
fields.doc: Radius of the hole; must be at least 0 and less than radius.

torus.label: Torus
torus.doc: A torus about the y axis, centred on the origin.

fields.name: major
fields.doc: Radius of the ring's centre line; must be positive.

fields.name: minor
fields.doc: Radius of the tube; must be positive.

quadric.label: Quadric
quadric.doc: The surface A x^2 + B y^2 + C z^2 + D xy + E xz + F yz + G x + H y + I z + J = 0, solid where negative.

fields.name: squares
fields.doc: Coefficients [A, B, C] of x^2, y^2, z^2.

fields.name: mixed
fields.doc: Coefficients [D, E, F] of xy, xz, yz.

fields.name: linear
fields.doc: Coefficients [G, H, I] of x, y, z.

fields.name: constant
fields.doc: Constant term J.

fields.name: bounds
fields.doc: Optional box the (possibly unbounded) surface is clipped to; absent means unclipped.

fields.name: min
fields.doc: One corner of the box.

fields.name: max
fields.doc: Opposite corner of the box.

poly.label: Polynomial surface
poly.doc: The zero surface of a polynomial in x, y and z of any order, solid where negative.

fields.name: order
fields.doc: Degree of the polynomial; needed (at least 1) when "coefficients" is used, ignored with "terms".

fields.name: coefficients
fields.doc: All coefficients of the polynomial in POV-Ray's order (x^2, xy, xz, x, y^2, yz, y, z^2, z, 1 for order 2; 20 for order 3, 35 for order 4); required unless "terms" is given.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: Alternative to "coefficients": list of [c, i, j, k] for the terms c x^i y^j z^k (whole-number powers); takes precedence.

fields.name: bounds
fields.doc: Optional box the (possibly unbounded) surface is clipped to; absent means unclipped.

fields.name: min
fields.doc: One corner of the box.

fields.name: max
fields.doc: Opposite corner of the box.

cubic.label: Cubic surface
cubic.doc: The zero surface of an order-3 polynomial in x, y and z, solid where negative.

fields.name: coefficients
fields.doc: All coefficients of the polynomial in POV-Ray's order (x^2, xy, xz, x, y^2, yz, y, z^2, z, 1 for order 2; 20 for order 3, 35 for order 4); required unless "terms" is given.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: Alternative to "coefficients": list of [c, i, j, k] for the terms c x^i y^j z^k (whole-number powers); takes precedence.

fields.name: bounds
fields.doc: Optional box the (possibly unbounded) surface is clipped to; absent means unclipped.

fields.name: min
fields.doc: One corner of the box.

fields.name: max
fields.doc: Opposite corner of the box.

quartic.label: Quartic surface
quartic.doc: The zero surface of an order-4 polynomial in x, y and z, solid where negative.

fields.name: coefficients
fields.doc: All coefficients of the polynomial in POV-Ray's order (x^2, xy, xz, x, y^2, yz, y, z^2, z, 1 for order 2; 20 for order 3, 35 for order 4); required unless "terms" is given.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: Alternative to "coefficients": list of [c, i, j, k] for the terms c x^i y^j z^k (whole-number powers); takes precedence.

fields.name: bounds
fields.doc: Optional box the (possibly unbounded) surface is clipped to; absent means unclipped.

fields.name: min
fields.doc: One corner of the box.

fields.name: max
fields.doc: Opposite corner of the box.

polygon.label: Polygon
polygon.doc: A flat polygon through coplanar 3D points, with holes where one loop lies inside another.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: At least three coplanar [x, y, z] points; a loop closes when its first point repeats, and further loops are holes.

prism.label: Prism
prism.doc: A 2D outline in the xz plane swept along y between two heights.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: Outline as [x, z] points; a loop closes when its first point repeats, loops inside others are holes.

fields.name: height1
fields.doc: y of one end.

fields.name: height2
fields.doc: y of the other end; must differ from height1.

fields.name: spline
fields.doc: How the points join; "bezier" takes four points per segment.

fields.name: steps
fields.doc: Straight pieces each bezier segment is flattened into (bezier only; 0 fails).

fields.name: sweep
fields.doc: "conic" scales the outline by its height towards an apex at y = 0, which the heights must not straddle.

fields.name: open
fields.doc: Leave the end faces off.

lathe.label: Lathe
lathe.doc: A 2D profile spun about the y axis.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: Profile as [radius, y] points: at least 2 for linear, 4 for cubic, a multiple of 4 for bezier.

fields.name: spline
fields.doc: "cubic" is a Catmull-Rom curve through all but the first and last points; "bezier" takes four points per segment.

sor.label: Surface of revolution
sor.doc: A profile spun about y whose squared radius is a cubic in y through all but the first and last points.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: At least four [radius, y] points with strictly increasing y.

fields.name: open
fields.doc: Leave the flat end caps off.

sphere_sweep.label: Sphere sweep
sphere_sweep.doc: The volume swept by a sphere moving, and changing radius, along a path.

fields.name: spheres
fields.doc: List of [x, y, z, radius]: at least 2 for linear, 4 for the curved splines.

fields.name: spline
fields.doc: "cubic" passes through all but the first and last spheres; "b_spline" passes near them.

fields.name: steps
fields.doc: Straight pieces per curved segment (not used by linear).

blob.label: Blob
blob.doc: Soft components whose fields add up, with the surface where the total reaches the threshold.

fields.name: threshold
fields.doc: Field value of the surface; must be positive.

fields.name: components
fields.doc: The field sources; each adds strength x (1 - d^2/r^2)^2 within its radius.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: Shape of the component.

fields.name: center
fields.doc: Centre (sphere components only, where it is required).

fields.name: base
fields.doc: One end of the axis (cylinder components only, where it is required).

fields.name: cap
fields.doc: Other end of the axis (cylinder components only, where it is required).

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Reach of the component's field; must be positive.

fields.name: strength
fields.doc: Field at the centre; negative carves away.

isosurface.label: Isosurface
isosurface.doc: The surface where a function of x, y and z equals a threshold, solid where it is less, inside a container.

fields.name: function
fields.doc: f(x, y, z). Text expression: numbers, + - * / ^, parentheses, pi, e, and sin cos tan asin acos atan atan2 sinh cosh tanh sqrt abs exp ln log floor ceil sqr pow min max mod noise3d select.

fields.name: threshold
fields.doc: Value of the function at the surface.

fields.name: contained_by
fields.doc: Container: {"box": {"min", "max"}} or {"sphere": {"center", "radius"}} (sphere wins if both); default the box from [-1, -1, -1] to [1, 1, 1].

fields.name: box
fields.doc: A box container.

fields.name: min
fields.doc: One corner.

fields.name: max
fields.doc: Opposite corner.

fields.name: sphere
fields.doc: A sphere container.

fields.name: center
fields.doc: Centre.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Radius.

fields.name: max_gradient
fields.doc: Upper bound on the function's slope; too low leaves holes, too high is slow; must be positive.

fields.name: accuracy
fields.doc: Distance tolerance of the root search; must be positive.

fields.name: open
fields.doc: Leave off the container's surface where it cuts the solid.

superellipsoid.label: Superellipsoid
superellipsoid.doc: (|x|^(2/e) + |y|^(2/e))^(e/n) + |z|^(2/n) = 1, a rounded box within the cube from -1 to 1.

fields.name: e
fields.doc: East-west exponent: 1 is round, near 0 square; must be positive.

fields.name: n
fields.doc: North-south exponent: 1 is round, near 0 square; must be positive.

julia_fractal.label: Julia fractal
julia_fractal.doc: A 3D slice of the quaternion Julia set of q^2 + c.

fields.name: c
fields.doc: The quaternion constant as four numbers [a, b, c, d].

fields.name: slice
fields.doc: Fourth component of every point of the 3D slice.

fields.name: max_iteration
fields.doc: Iterations before a point counts as inside; must be positive.

fields.name: accuracy
fields.doc: Distance tolerance of the surface search; must be positive.

text.label: Text
text.doc: Extruded letters from a font, about one unit high on the baseline y = 0 from x = 0, from z = 0 back to z = thickness.

fields.name: font
fields.doc: TrueType or OpenType font file; or a list of files, of which the first that exists is used.

fields.name: string
fields.doc: The text; must have at least one visible glyph.

fields.name: thickness
fields.doc: Depth of the letters along z; must be positive.

fields.name: offset
fields.doc: Extra [x, y] shift added after each character, beyond its advance width.

fields.name: steps
fields.doc: Edges each glyph curve is flattened into.

bilinear_patch.label: Bilinear patch
bilinear_patch.doc: The surface between four corners, flat or a saddle.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: The four corners [p00, p10, p01, p11], each [x, y, z].

quad.label: Quad
quad.doc: A flat four-cornered sheet (a bilinear patch with coplanar corners); with an emitting material, an area light.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: The four corners [p00, p10, p01, p11], each [x, y, z].

curves.label: Curves
curves.doc: Cubic Bézier strands with width, as flat ribbons facing the ray, cylinders (for the hair material) or oriented ribbons.

fields.name: curves
fields.doc: The strands.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: The four control points, each [x, y, z].

fields.name: width
fields.doc: Width: a number, or [root, tip].

fields.name: normals
fields.doc: Kind ribbon (required there): the surface normals at the two ends.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: How the strands are shaped; a ribbon takes each curve's "normals".

fields.name: split
fields.doc: Times each curve is halved for its bounds (2^split segments).

fur.label: Fur
fur.doc: A ball of fur: curved strands growing from a sphere, leaning out and drooping.

fields.name: center
fields.doc: Centre of the sphere.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Radius of the sphere the strands grow from.

fields.name: count
fields.doc: Number of strands.

fields.name: length
fields.doc: Length of a strand.

fields.name: width
fields.doc: Width at the root (the tip a fifth of it), or [root, tip].

fields.name: droop
fields.doc: The tip's fall under gravity, as a fraction of the length.

fields.name: curl
fields.doc: Random sideways bend, as a fraction of the length.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: How the strands are shaped.

fields.name: split
fields.doc: Times each strand is halved for its bounds.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Chooses the strands.

mesh.label: Mesh
mesh.doc: A triangle mesh from an OBJ file, flat shaded; each file and scale is loaded once and shared.

fields.name: src
fields.doc: OBJ file, relative to where the renderer runs.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: [x, y, z] factors applied to the vertices.

smoothmesh.label: Smooth mesh
smoothmesh.doc: A triangle mesh from an OBJ file, shaded with interpolated vertex normals.

fields.name: src
fields.doc: OBJ file, relative to where the renderer runs.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: [x, y, z] factors applied to the vertices.

height_field.label: Height field
height_field.doc: A triangulated surface over the unit square in x and z, with heights from an image's brightness or a function.

fields.name: src
fields.doc: Image whose brightness gives heights 0 to 1 (top row at z = 1); takes precedence; one of src or function is required.

fields.name: function
fields.doc: Height as f(x, z) over 0 to 1, used when there is no src. Text expression: numbers, + - * / ^, parentheses, pi, e, and sin cos tan asin acos atan atan2 sinh cosh tanh sqrt abs exp ln log floor ceil sqr pow min max mod noise3d select.

fields.name: resolution
fields.doc: [cells in x, cells in z] sampled from the function (not used with src).

fields.name: smooth
fields.doc: Interpolate normals from the slope instead of flat facets.

fields.name: water_level
fields.doc: Triangles entirely below this height are left out.

parametric.label: Parametric surface
parametric.doc: The surface (x(u, v), y(u, v), z(u, v)), triangulated on a grid with smooth normals.

fields.name: x
fields.doc: x as a function of u and v. Text expression: numbers, + - * / ^, parentheses, pi, e, and sin cos tan asin acos atan atan2 sinh cosh tanh sqrt abs exp ln log floor ceil sqr pow min max mod noise3d select.

fields.name: y
fields.doc: y as a function of u and v (same syntax as x).

fields.name: z
fields.doc: z as a function of u and v (same syntax as x).

fields.name: u
fields.doc: Range [u0, u1] of u.

fields.name: v
fields.doc: Range [v0, v1] of v.

fields.name: resolution
fields.doc: [cells in u, cells in v] of the grid; each at least 1.

bicubic_patch.label: Bicubic patch
bicubic_patch.doc: A Bezier patch from a 4 by 4 grid of control points, triangulated with smooth normals.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: Exactly 16 [x, y, z] control points, four rows of four.

fields.name: steps
fields.doc: Cells each way the patch is divided into; at least 1.

subdivision.label: Subdivision surface
subdivision.doc: A Loop subdivision surface: the smooth limit of a triangle mesh.

fields.name: src
fields.doc: Mesh file whose triangles are the control mesh; or give points and triangles.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: The control mesh's vertices, each [x, y, z] (required without src).

fields.name: triangles
fields.doc: Its triangles, each [a, b, c] indices into points (required without src).

fields.name: levels
fields.doc: Times the mesh is refined; each quadruples the triangles.

rotate.label: Rotate
rotate.doc: Another shape, rotated about the origin by Euler angles.

fields.name: item
fields.doc: The shape to rotate.

fields.name: roll
fields.doc: Degrees about the x axis.

fields.name: pitch
fields.doc: Degrees about the y axis.

fields.name: yaw
fields.doc: Degrees about the z axis.

transform.label: Transform
transform.doc: Another shape scaled, rotated and moved; with a named geometry as item, an instance of it.

fields.name: item
fields.doc: The shape to transform.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: A number, or [x, y, z] factors; applied first.

fields.name: rotate
fields.doc: Euler angles, applied after scale.

fields.name: roll
fields.doc: Degrees about the x axis.

fields.name: pitch
fields.doc: Degrees about the y axis.

fields.name: yaw
fields.doc: Degrees about the z axis.

fields.name: translate
fields.doc: Movement, applied last.

fields.name: steps
fields.doc: Instead of scale, rotate and translate (not both): a list of transform steps applied in order (see transform_step).

fields.name: motion
fields.doc: Motion blur: the transform's keys at the end of the motion (shutter time 1), each defaulting to its value at the start.

fields.name: translate
fields.doc: Translation at the end.

fields.name: rotate
fields.doc: Rotation at the end, as "rotate".

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Scale at the end, as "scale".

fields.name: steps
fields.doc: Steps at the end, in place of the three above.

union.label: Union
union.doc: CSG union: everything inside any of its shapes, inner surfaces kept.

fields.name: items
fields.doc: The shapes combined; at least one. An item with its own material or medium keeps it.

merge.label: Merge
merge.doc: CSG merge: a union with the surfaces inside other items removed (for transparent materials).

fields.name: items
fields.doc: The shapes combined; at least one. An item with its own material or medium keeps it.

intersection.label: Intersection
intersection.doc: CSG intersection: what is inside all of its shapes.

fields.name: items
fields.doc: The shapes combined; at least one. An item with its own material or medium keeps it.

difference.label: Difference
difference.doc: CSG difference: the first shape with the others cut away.

fields.name: items
fields.doc: The first shape less all the others; required unless "a" is given.

fields.name: a
fields.doc: Alternative to items: the shape cut from.

fields.name: b
fields.doc: Alternative to items: the shape cut away (required with a).

box_terrain.label: Box terrain
box_terrain.doc: A fixed-size blocky landscape of boxes with noise heights and its own materials.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Chooses the heights.

terrain.label: Heightmap terrain
terrain.doc: Ground whose height comes from a heightmap: flat, fractal noise or an image.

fields.name: heightmap
fields.doc: The heights: see its fields. Absent: a flat 20 x 20 square at y = 0.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: Where heights come from.

fields.name: min
fields.doc: [x, z] corner of the area covered.

fields.name: max
fields.doc: Opposite [x, z] corner.

fields.name: resolution
fields.doc: Grid cells along the longest side (ignored if cell_size is given).

fields.name: cell_size
fields.doc: Size of a grid cell, in scene units; default is the longest side / resolution.

fields.name: base
fields.doc: Height (y) of the ground's base level.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Noise and mesas types: chooses the pattern.

fields.name: amplitude
fields.doc: Noise type: height of the relief either side of base.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Noise type: horizontal size of the largest features. Mesas type: size of the mesas (default 800).

fields.name: octaves
fields.doc: Noise type: layers of finer detail.

fields.name: persistence
fields.doc: Noise type: amplitude of each octave relative to the last.

fields.name: lacunarity
fields.doc: Noise type: frequency of each octave relative to the last.

fields.name: ridged
fields.doc: Noise type: ridged noise, for sharp crests.

fields.name: src
fields.doc: Image type (required there): greyscale image file of heights.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Image type: height of a white pixel above base. Mesas type: height of the tops above base (default 120).

fields.name: coverage
fields.doc: Mesas type: fraction of the area the mesas cover.

fields.name: cliff
fields.doc: Mesas type: width of the cliff band, m.

fields.name: benches
fields.doc: Mesas type: ledges in the cliff.

fields.name: talus
fields.doc: Mesas type: height of the scree apron, as a fraction of height.

fields.name: talus_width
fields.doc: Mesas type: width of the scree apron, m; default height.

fields.name: floor_amplitude
fields.doc: Mesas type: height of the floor's undulation, m.

fields.name: floor_scale
fields.doc: Mesas type: size of the floor's undulation, m.

fields.name: clearing
fields.doc: Mesas type: [x, z, radius], a circle kept free of mesas (eg. round the camera).

fields.name: domain
fields.doc: Mesas type: [min x, min z, max x, max z], the area the mesas are laid out over; default the heightmap's own.

fields.name: towers
fields.doc: Mesas type: free-standing spires and fins per square kilometre.

fields.name: relief
fields.doc: Mesas type: rounded hills left on the tops, as a fraction of height.

fields.name: height_variation
fields.doc: Mesas type: variation of height from mesa to mesa, a fraction.

fields.name: roughness
fields.doc: Mesas type: gullies and fallen blocks on the debris slopes, 0 to 1.

fields.name: floor_ledges
fields.doc: Mesas type: height of the low steps the floor is terraced in, m.

fields.name: domes
fields.doc: Mesas type: size of the slickrock domes the tops weather into, m; 0 for none.

fields.name: hole
fields.doc: Mesas type: [min x, min z, max x, max z], a rectangle sunk out of sight (where a finer grid takes over).

fields.name: uplift
fields.doc: Mesas type: [x, z, radius, height], a taller mesa placed there.

fields.name: valley
fields.doc: Mesas type: [x, z, inner, outer]: few mesas near (x, z), tablelands past outer.

fields.name: buttes
fields.doc: Mesas type: [[x, z, radius], ...], buttes placed by hand.

fields.name: joints
fields.doc: Mesas type: [spacing, depth] of vertical joints weathered into slots, m.

fields.name: taper
fields.doc: Mesas type: how much the cliffs' steepness varies.

fields.name: shoulder
fields.doc: Mesas type: rounding of the rims, a fraction of height.

fields.name: washes
fields.doc: Mesas type: depth of dry washes across the floor, m.

fields.name: laminae
fields.doc: Mesas type: a rock material's cross-bedding as relief on the tops.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: The rock material's seed.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: The rock material's scale.

fields.name: set
fields.doc: The rock material's cross_set.

fields.name: relief
fields.doc: Relief between the softest and hardest laminae, m.

landscape.label: Landscape (simulated)
landscape.doc: Terrain grown by simulating tectonics, uplift, river and glacial erosion, volcanoes and sediment. With "scale", a model of a patch (or of the whole planet) scaled into the scene; without it, the landscape at full size, in metres, over the whole planet, finest near the camera.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Chooses the planet.

fields.name: time
fields.doc: Years of landscape evolution to simulate; 0 shows the initial noise topography.

fields.name: cache
fields.doc: Directory where simulated states are kept and reused.

fields.name: domain
fields.doc: What is simulated; absent: a 128-cell patch at the most mountainous place. At full scale: the site at the scene's origin and the finest patch.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: Scaled model: a patch of the planet, or the whole sphere.

fields.name: cells
fields.doc: Patch: cells along a side; planet: resolution of the sphere's grid (default 64 there).

fields.name: spacing
fields.doc: Patch: cell size, m (default 750 at full scale).

fields.name: lat
fields.doc: Patch: latitude of its centre, degrees; needs lon too.

fields.name: lon
fields.doc: Patch: longitude of its centre, degrees.

fields.name: near
fields.doc: Patch without lat/lon: centre it on the most such place.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Metres of terrain per scene unit (eg. 1000), for a scaled model; absent: full scale on the scene's planet.

fields.name: exaggeration
fields.doc: Vertical exaggeration.

fields.name: centre
fields.doc: Scaled model: scene position of the patch's centre at sea level.

fields.name: min_river_width
fields.doc: Draw rivers at least this wide, m.

fields.name: map
fields.doc: Also write a shaded relief map image of the (finest) patch here.

fields.name: step
fields.doc: Length of a landscape evolution step, years.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Planet radius, m; at full scale the default is 6360000, the scene planet's.

fields.name: land_bias
fields.doc: Positive makes more land, negative more sea.

fields.name: mountain_height
fields.doc: Height of the initial mountains above the plains, m.

fields.name: uplift_rate
fields.doc: Peak tectonic uplift, m per year.

fields.name: belt_frequency
fields.doc: Mountain belts per planet radius.

fields.name: tectonics
fields.doc: Plate tectonics shaping the continents: on with defaults at full scale, off (noise alone) in a scaled model unless given; false for none.

fields.name: cells
fields.doc: Grid cells per cube face edge.

fields.name: plates
fields.doc: Plates at the start.

fields.name: age
fields.doc: Million years simulated.

fields.name: step
fields.doc: Million years per step.

fields.name: continental_fraction
fields.doc: Fraction of the surface that is continent at the start.

fields.name: speed
fields.doc: Typical plate speed, km per million years.

fields.name: rift_interval
fields.doc: Mean time between rifting events, million years.

fields.name: subduction_uplift
fields.doc: Thickening behind a subduction zone, m per million years.

fields.name: collision_uplift
fields.doc: Thickening where continents collide, m per million years.

fields.name: relaxation
fields.doc: Relaxation time of thickened crust, million years.

fields.name: hotspots
fields.doc: Number of hotspots.

fields.name: remesh
fields.doc: Million years between resamplings of the plates.

fields.name: climate
fields.doc: Climate by latitude (temperature, rain, snow line): on with defaults at full scale, off in a scaled model unless given; false for none.

fields.name: tilt
fields.doc: Axial tilt, degrees.

fields.name: solar
fields.doc: Solar constant, W/m².

fields.name: hadley
fields.doc: Latitude of the dry subtropics, degrees.

fields.name: cells
fields.doc: Grid cells per cube face edge.

fields.name: recycling
fields.doc: Distance over which air crossing land rains out its moisture, m.

fields.name: orographic
fields.doc: Rise over which air loses 1/e of its moisture, m.

fields.name: warming
fields.doc: Added to every temperature, °C.

fields.name: strata_thickness
fields.doc: Thickness of one hard plus one soft bedrock layer, m.

fields.name: strata_contrast
fields.doc: Ratio of erodibility between softest and hardest bedrock.

fields.name: fold_amplitude
fields.doc: How far bedrock layers are folded up and down, m.

fields.name: sediment_erodibility
fields.doc: Erodibility of sediment relative to average bedrock.

fields.name: lava_erodibility
fields.doc: Erodibility of volcanic rock relative to average bedrock.

fields.name: fluvial
fields.doc: River erosion (stream power law) parameters.

fields.name: k
fields.doc: Erodibility K, m^(1-2m) per year.

fields.name: m
fields.doc: Drainage area exponent.

fields.name: n
fields.doc: Slope exponent.

fields.name: diffusivity
fields.doc: Hillslope diffusivity, m² per year.

fields.name: deposition
fields.doc: Deposition coefficient G; 0 for none.

fields.name: volcanoes
fields.doc: Volcano parameters; false for no volcanoes; absent: defaults.

fields.name: spacing
fields.doc: Spacing of possible vents, m.

fields.name: density
fields.doc: Chance a possible vent exists where volcanism is strongest.

fields.name: horizon
fields.doc: Vents start erupting at random times up to this, years.

fields.name: duration
fields.doc: Typical eruptive lifetime of a vent, years.

fields.name: rate
fields.doc: Typical eruption rate, m³ per year.

fields.name: cone_radius
fields.doc: Radius of a cone, m.

fields.name: lava_fraction
fields.doc: Share of erupted volume that flows away as lava.

fields.name: flow_thickness
fields.doc: Thickness of a lava flow, m.

fields.name: roughness
fields.doc: Random perturbation of the ground steering lava, m.

fields.name: channels
fields.doc: Meandering rivers (patches only); false for none; absent: defaults.

fields.name: min_area
fields.doc: Smallest drainage area of a meandering river, m².

fields.name: max_slope
fields.doc: Steepest slope a river meanders on.

fields.name: min_sediment
fields.doc: Thinnest sediment a river meanders over, m.

fields.name: width_coefficient
fields.doc: Channel width is this times the square root of drainage area.

fields.name: migration
fields.doc: Bank erodibility.

fields.name: friction
fields.doc: Friction factor.

fields.name: omega
fields.doc: Weight of local curvature.

fields.name: gamma
fields.doc: Weight of upstream curvature.

fields.name: regrid
fields.doc: How often reaches are found again, years.

fields.name: oxbow_fill
fields.doc: Rate ox-bow lakes fill with sediment, m per year.

fields.name: marine
fields.doc: Sediment deposited in the sea; false to let it leave the model; absent: defaults.

fields.name: diffusivity
fields.doc: Diffusivity at the shore, m² per year.

fields.name: depth_scale
fields.doc: Depth over which diffusivity falls by e, m.

fields.name: glacier
fields.doc: Glaciers and ice erosion; false for none; absent: defaults.

fields.name: glen_a
fields.doc: Glen's flow law rate factor A, Pa^-n per year.

fields.name: glen_n
fields.doc: Glen's exponent.

fields.name: sliding
fields.doc: Sliding coefficient.

fields.name: erosion
fields.doc: Glacial erosion coefficient.

fields.name: erosion_exponent
fields.doc: Glacial erosion exponent.

fields.name: ela_equator
fields.doc: Snow line (equilibrium line altitude) at the equator, m.

fields.name: ela_pole
fields.doc: Snow line at the poles, m.

fields.name: ela_amplitude
fields.doc: Swing of the snow line over a glacial cycle, m.

fields.name: period
fields.doc: Glacial cycle period, years.

fields.name: balance_gradient
fields.doc: Mass balance gradient, per year.

fields.name: max_accumulation
fields.doc: Most snowfall, m of ice per year.

fields.name: max_step
fields.doc: Longest ice time step, years.

fields.name: min_step
fields.doc: Shortest ice time step, years.

fields.name: max_speed
fields.doc: Fastest ice, m per year.

fields.name: max_stiffness
fields.doc: Largest ice step relative to the fastest diffusion.

fields.name: acceleration
fields.doc: Years of landscape evolution per year of ice flow.

fields.name: picard
fields.doc: Solves per ice step.

fields.name: planet
fields.doc: Full scale: the whole planet's simulation driving the patches; false for its noise topography alone.

fields.name: cells
fields.doc: Cells per face edge.

fields.name: levels
fields.doc: Full scale: the nested patches, finest first; default the domain's and coarser ones five times wider apart; [] for none (as from orbit).

fields.name: cells
fields.doc: Cells along a side.

fields.name: spacing
fields.doc: Cell size, m.

fields.name: focus
fields.doc: Full scale: scene point the patches centre on; default the ground the camera looks over.

fields.name: resolution
fields.doc: Full scale: vertices along a ring of the mesh.

fields.name: min_spacing
fields.doc: Full scale: finest spacing of the mesh, m.

fields.name: globe
fields.doc: Full scale: mesh cells per face edge beyond the rings.

fields.name: roughness
fields.doc: Full scale: strength of the detail below the finest cells.

fields.name: snowline
fields.doc: Full scale: height of the snow line, m; default from the climate.

fields.name: treeline
fields.doc: Full scale: height of the tree line, m; default from the climate.

fields.name: planet_map
fields.doc: Full scale: also write a map of the whole planet here.

fields.name: climate_map
fields.doc: Full scale: also write a map of the climate here.

fields.name: camera
fields.doc: Full scale: {"location", "lookat"} the mesh is finest near; filled in from the scene's camera if absent.

planet.label: Planet
planet.doc: The ground as a sphere whose top is at the origin, so that what is far away drops below the horizon.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Radius of the planet, m (default the Earth's, matching the skysphere).

mountains.label: Mountains
mountains.doc: A mountain range: a meshed heightfield of ridged noise around a massif, lying on the planet, with its own snow, rock and vegetation material (material and medium are ignored).

fields.name: center
fields.doc: Middle of the square of terrain, [x, z].

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: How far the terrain reaches either side of the centre, m.

fields.name: resolution
fields.doc: Vertices along each side; build time grows with its square.

fields.name: peak
fields.doc: Where the massif's summit is, [x, z]; default the centre.

fields.name: peak_height
fields.doc: Height the massif rises, m.

fields.name: peak_radius
fields.doc: Width of the massif, m.

fields.name: relief
fields.doc: Height of the ridged relief, m.

fields.name: feature_size
fields.doc: Size of the largest ridges, m.

fields.name: plains
fields.doc: Rolling relief of the plains around, m.

fields.name: base
fields.doc: Height of its foot above the planet's surface, m; below zero for an island in a sea.

fields.name: mapping
fields.doc: "flat" for flat ground; anything else follows the planet's curve.

fields.name: earth_radius
fields.doc: Radius of the planet the ground follows, m (unless flat).

fields.name: snowline
fields.doc: Height above which snow lies on gentle slopes, m.

fields.name: treeline
fields.doc: Height above which only rock shows, m.

fields.name: snow
fields.doc: Colour of snow.

fields.name: rock
fields.doc: Colour of bare rock.

fields.name: forest
fields.doc: Colour of forest.

fields.name: grass
fields.doc: Colour of grassland.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Chooses the terrain's noise.

ocean.label: Ocean
ocean.doc: A sea of Tessendorf waves on the planet's surface, physically lit (sun glitter, Fresnel sky reflection), displaced near detail_center and shaded by its slopes beyond. A material or medium given replaces the ocean's own.

fields.name: wind
fields.doc: Wind velocity [x, z], m/s.

fields.name: time
fields.doc: Time of the wave animation, s.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Random realisation of the waves.

fields.name: amplitude
fields.doc: Phillips spectrum constant A (wave height squared); default set from "resolved".

fields.name: resolved
fields.doc: Fraction of Cox and Munk's mean square slope carried by the displaced waves (ignored with "amplitude").

fields.name: planet_radius
fields.doc: Radius of the planet whose surface the sea is, m; 0 or less for a flat sea at y = 0.

fields.name: water
fields.doc: Albedo of the water body.

fields.name: roughness
fields.doc: Mean square slope of unresolved ripples; default Cox and Munk's for the wind less the waves' own.

fields.name: detail_center
fields.doc: [x, z] around which waves are displaced geometry (put it under the camera).

fields.name: detail_distance
fields.doc: Distance from detail_center over which waves are displaced, m.

fields.name: debug
fields.doc: Shade by surface normal.

skysphere.label: Sky
skysphere.doc: The sky all around the scene: Rayleigh and Mie scattering in a planet's atmosphere, with the sun's disc; its own material, so material and medium are ignored.

fields.name: preset
fields.doc: Atmosphere whose scattering values are the defaults below; an unknown name means earth.

fields.name: sun_direction
fields.doc: Direction towards the sun (normalised); a scene "sun" follows it.

fields.name: brightness
fields.doc: Multiplier on the sky's radiance; not allowed with a scene "sun", whose intensity sets it.

fields.name: rayleigh_r
fields.doc: Rayleigh scattering coefficient for red, per metre at sea level (from the preset; earth shown).

fields.name: rayleigh_g
fields.doc: Rayleigh scattering coefficient for green, per metre (from the preset).

fields.name: rayleigh_b
fields.doc: Rayleigh scattering coefficient for blue, per metre (from the preset).

fields.name: mie_coefficient
fields.doc: Mie (haze) scattering coefficient, per metre at sea level (preset: earth 21e-6, sunset 25e-6, hazy 45e-6).

fields.name: mie_anisotropy
fields.doc: Mie phase anisotropy g (preset: earth 0.76, sunset 0.85, hazy 0.9).

fields.name: rayleigh_thickness
fields.doc: Scale height of the air, m (from the preset).

fields.name: mie_thickness
fields.doc: Scale height of the haze, m (from the preset).

fields.name: earth_location
fields.doc: Centre of the planet; the default puts its surface at the origin.

fields.name: earth_radius
fields.doc: Radius of the planet, m.

fields.name: atmosphere_radius
fields.doc: Radius of the top of the atmosphere, m.

fields.name: ozone
fields.doc: Absorption by the ozone layer; false turns it off.

fields.name: multiple_scattering
fields.doc: Add light scattered more than once in the atmosphere.

fields.name: ground_albedo
fields.doc: Reflectance of the planet's ground, as it lights the air (multiple scattering).

fields.name: crepuscular_rays
fields.doc: Let clouds and terrain shadow the air, making sunbeams (slower).

fields.name: aerial_perspective
fields.doc: Attenuate and haze distant objects by this atmosphere; false turns it off.

fields.name: lut
fields.doc: Look the sky up in a precomputed table; false integrates every ray exactly.

fields.name: moonlight
fields.doc: Set by the scene when a moon lights it: {"direction", "share"} of the sun's light.

moon.label: Moon
moon.doc: A cratered moon or other airless world at its true size and distance, lit by the sun (Hapke's model) and its planet's earthshine; it takes none of the common object keys.

fields.name: preset
fields.doc: The world: a real one, or a rocky or icy one drawn from the seed; it sets the radius, craters and colours.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Chooses the surface.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Radius, m (default from the preset; the Moon's shown).

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: Direction in which it is seen from "from".

fields.name: distance
fields.doc: Its distance from the planet's centre, m.

fields.name: from
fields.doc: The point it is seen from in "direction".

fields.name: position
fields.doc: Its centre, in place of direction and distance.

fields.name: orbit

fields.doc: Smallest and largest pebble size.

fields.name: packing
fields.doc: Below 1 (eg. 0.75) packs them closer, leaning on each other.

fields.name: slope
fields.doc: Rise of the ground per unit x and per unit z.

fields.name: materials
fields.doc: Materials to mix, one per pebble; overrides material and medium.

fields.name: wetness
fields.doc: Wetness of the default stone mix, 0 to 1.

fields.name: detail
fields.doc: Geodesic subdivisions of each pebble's mesh.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Chooses the scatter and shapes.

bedrock.label: Bedrock
bedrock.doc: A rock outcrop rising from the ground; without a material or medium it is a rock material, sandstone if it has strata, else granite.

fields.name: center
fields.doc: Middle of its base.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Extent of its base, [x, z].

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Height it rises.

fields.name: feature_size
fields.doc: Size of its largest forms; default a quarter of the smaller side.

fields.name: strata
fields.doc: Thickness of its terraced beds; 0 for none.

fields.name: strata_strength
fields.doc: How strongly the beds terrace it, 0 to 1.

fields.name: falloff
fields.doc: Fraction of each side over which it slopes down to the base.

fields.name: resolution
fields.doc: Vertices along a side.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Chooses the shape (and the default material's pattern).

firework.label: Firework
firework.doc: A burst of glowing particle trails, drawn as it is some time after the explosion.

fields.name: center
fields.doc: Where it explodes.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Seeds the particles; absent: derived from center.

fields.name: time
fields.doc: Time since the explosion; trails grow and fall with it.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Radius of the explosion at time 1.

fields.name: samples
fields.doc: Spheres along each particle's trail.

fields.name: gravity
fields.doc: Downward acceleration.

fields.name: particles
fields.doc: Number of particles.

fields.name: upward_bias
fields.doc: Extra upward velocity of the particles.

fields.name: intensity
fields.doc: Brightness multiplier on color.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Colour of the glow.

fields.name: albedo
fields.doc: Fraction of light reflected, per channel. A texture object is also accepted: {"texture": file, "scale", "offset", "filter": ewa|trilinear|bilinear|point, "wrap": repeat|clamp|black, "linear"}, or a grey level by {"slope": [from, to]} or {"height": [from, to]} (with "jitter", "jitter_scale", "seed"), or {"terrain": washes|hollows|joints, "scale", "spread"}.

fields.name: reflective
fields.doc: Colour of the reflection.

fields.name: roughness
fields.doc: Blur of the reflection; 0 is a perfect mirror.

plastic.label: Plastic
plastic.doc: An opaque diffuse base under a clear glossy coat.

fields.name: albedo
fields.doc: Colour of the diffuse base. A texture object is also accepted: {"texture": file, "scale", "offset", "filter": ewa|trilinear|bilinear|point, "wrap": repeat|clamp|black, "linear"}, or a grey level by {"slope": [from, to]} or {"height": [from, to]} (with "jitter", "jitter_scale", "seed"), or {"terrain": washes|hollows|joints, "scale", "spread"}.

fields.name: refractive_index
fields.doc: Index of the coat, setting how much it reflects.

fields.name: roughness
fields.doc: Blur of the coat's reflection.

leaf.label: Leaf
leaf.doc: A thin translucent leaf: reflects and transmits diffusely under a glossy coat; reflectance + transmittance must not exceed 1 in any channel.

fields.name: reflectance
fields.doc: Fraction of light the healthy leaf reflects diffusely.

fields.name: transmittance
fields.doc: Fraction that passes through, diffusely.

fields.name: refractive_index
fields.doc: Index of the waxy coat.

fields.name: roughness
fields.doc: Roughness of the coat's highlight.

fields.name: autumn
fields.doc: Colour of a tree's autumn leaves.

fields.name: reflectance
fields.doc: Fraction reflected.

fields.name: transmittance
fields.doc: Fraction transmitted.

fields.name: autumn_sun
fields.doc: Autumn colour of leaves in the sun; default (and each field's default) as autumn.

fields.name: reflectance
fields.doc: Fraction reflected.

fields.name: transmittance
fields.doc: Fraction transmitted.

fields.name: dead
fields.doc: Colour of leaves on dead branches.

fields.name: reflectance
fields.doc: Fraction reflected.

fields.name: transmittance
fields.doc: Fraction transmitted.

dielectric.label: Dielectric (glass)
dielectric.doc: A clear refracting material such as glass or water.

fields.name: refractive_index
fields.doc: Index of refraction (glass 1.5, water 1.33). A number, a glass name (BK7, fused silica, SF11, diamond), {"cauchy": [a, b]} or {"sellmeier": {"b": [..], "c": [..]}}; these disperse in spectral mode.

fields.name: attenuate
fields.doc: Tint applied to light passing through or reflected.

diffuse-light.label: Diffuse light
diffuse-light.doc: An emitting surface; objects with it become area lights.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Colour emitted; not with temperature.

fields.name: temperature
fields.doc: In place of color: a blackbody of this temperature, kelvin, scaled to unit luminance.

fields.name: intensity
fields.doc: Multiplier on the emission.

fields.name: two_sided
fields.doc: Emit from the back of the surface too.

fields.name: texture
fields.doc: An image that scales the emission over the surface (eg. a screen).

fields.name: texture
fields.doc: The image file.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Repeats across the texture coordinates: a number or [u, v].

fields.name: offset
fields.doc: Shift of the texture coordinates: a number or [u, v].

fields.name: filter
fields.doc: How the image is filtered.

fields.name: wrap
fields.doc: What lies beyond the image's edges.

fields.name: linear
fields.doc: The image holds linear values; default by its format (8-bit images are sRGB).

fields.name: color
fields.doc: The colour.

whitted.label: Whitted
whitted.doc: Legacy Whitted-style shading from point lights: diffuse, Phong highlight and mirror reflection.

fields.name: pigment
fields.doc: Surface colour.

fields.name: reflection
fields.doc: Fraction mirrored, 0 to 1.

fields.name: phong
fields.doc: Strength of the Phong highlight.

normal.label: Normal shading
normal.doc: Colours the surface by its normal, for debugging.

rock.label: Rock
rock.doc: Procedural stone: grains, strata, cracks and bumps, by preset.

fields.name: preset
fields.doc: Kind of stone; every style field below defaults from it.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Main colour (default from the preset; granite's shown).

fields.name: secondary
fields.doc: Second colour it mottles toward (default from the preset; granite's shown).

fields.name: dark_grain
fields.doc: Colour of dark mineral grains (default from the preset; granite's shown).

fields.name: dark_grain_amount
fields.doc: Share of the surface that is dark grains (default from the preset; granite's shown).

fields.name: light_grain
fields.doc: Colour of light mineral grains (default from the preset; granite's shown).

fields.name: light_grain_amount
fields.doc: Share that is light grains (default from the preset; granite's shown).

fields.name: grain_size
fields.doc: Size of grains, in units of scale (default from the preset; granite's shown).

fields.name: strata_spacing
fields.doc: Thickness of layers (default from the preset; granite's shown).

fields.name: strata_color
fields.doc: Colour of the layers (default from the preset; granite's shown).

fields.name: strata_amount
fields.doc: Strength of the layering, 0 for none (default from the preset; granite's shown).

fields.name: bump
fields.doc: Strength of surface bumps (default from the preset; granite's shown).

fields.name: bump_size
fields.doc: Size of the bumps (default from the preset; granite's shown).

fields.name: cracks
fields.doc: Strength of cracks (default from the preset; granite's shown).

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Size of the texture's features, scene units (1 for metres).

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Chooses the pattern.

fields.name: weathering
fields.doc: Broad variation in tone; 0 for none.

fields.name: wetness
fields.doc: Darker and glossier.

fields.name: lichen
fields.doc: Fraction of upward-facing surface covered in lichen, 0 to 1.

fields.name: lichen_color
fields.doc: Colour of the lichen (used when lichen > 0).

fields.name: layers
fields.doc: Formations' colours by elevation: [[y, colour], ...].

fields.name: layer_warp
fields.doc: How far the layers' boundaries are warped.

fields.name: beds
fields.doc: A list of colours, one per bed of the strata.

fields.name: variety
fields.doc: Strength of broad stains.

fields.name: variety_color
fields.doc: Colour of the stains.

fields.name: varnish
fields.doc: Dark streaks down steep faces (desert varnish).

fields.name: varnish_color
fields.doc: Colour of the varnish.

fields.name: flutes
fields.doc: Strength of vertical grooves, bump mapped.

fields.name: cross_bedding
fields.doc: Strength of inclined laminae (cross-bedding).

fields.name: cross_set
fields.doc: Thickness of a set of cross-beds, in units of scale.

fields.name: pits
fields.doc: Honeycomb weathering.

fields.name: pit_size
fields.doc: Size of the pits, in units of scale.

fields.name: fractal
fields.doc: Strength of turbulent relief down to a pixel's size, for close-ups.

fields.name: fractal_size
fields.doc: Size of its largest features, in units of scale.

fields.name: fractal_h
fields.doc: Its roughness exponent: lower is rougher.

fields.name: crackle
fields.doc: Strength of fractures.

fields.name: crackle_size
fields.doc: Spacing of the fractures, in units of scale.

noise.label: Noise texture
noise.doc: A base material with its colour varied by procedural noise.

fields.name: base_material
fields.doc: Material whose colour is varied; absent (or unknown): white lambertian.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Colour blended in by the noise (also a name: black, white, red, green, blue).

fields.name: blend_factor
fields.doc: How strongly the noise colour is blended in, 0 to 1.

fields.name: noise_type
fields.doc: Kind of noise (anything unrecognised is perlin).

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Frequency of the pattern: the point is multiplied by this.

fields.name: octaves
fields.doc: fbm and turbulence: layers of detail.

fields.name: persistence
fields.doc: fbm: amplitude of each octave relative to the last.

fields.name: lacunarity
fields.doc: fbm: frequency of each octave relative to the last.

fields.name: point_density
fields.doc: worley: feature points per unit cell.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Seeds the pattern; absent: Perlin's reference table (and Worley seed 42).

conductor.label: Conductor
conductor.doc: A metal with a GGX microfacet surface, from measured optical constants, eta and k, or a reflectance; optionally anisotropic.

fields.name: metal
fields.doc: A measured metal: silver, aluminium, gold, copper or brass.

fields.name: eta
fields.doc: Without metal: refractive index per channel (with k; default white if only k is given).

fields.name: k
fields.doc: Without metal: absorption index per channel (default black if only eta is given).

fields.name: reflectance
fields.doc: Without metal, eta or k: the colour reflected at normal incidence.

fields.name: roughness
fields.doc: GGX roughness; 0 is a mirror.

fields.name: roughness_u
fields.doc: Roughness along tangent, for brushed metal; default roughness.

fields.name: roughness_v
fields.doc: Roughness across tangent; default roughness.

fields.name: tangent
fields.doc: Direction of the brushing.

coated_diffuse.label: Coated diffuse
coated_diffuse.doc: A diffuse base under a clear dielectric coat (pbrt's layered material): varnished or glazed surfaces.

fields.name: albedo
fields.doc: Colour of the diffuse base. A texture object is also accepted: {"texture": file, "scale", "offset", "filter": ewa|trilinear|bilinear|point, "wrap": repeat|clamp|black, "linear"}, or a grey level by {"slope": [from, to]} or {"height": [from, to]} (with "jitter", "jitter_scale", "seed"), or {"terrain": washes|hollows|joints, "scale", "spread"}.

fields.name: roughness
fields.doc: Roughness of the coat.

fields.name: refractive_index
fields.doc: Index of the coat.

fields.name: thickness
fields.doc: Thickness of the layer between coat and base; must be positive.

fields.name: medium_albedo
fields.doc: Albedo of a scattering medium between coat and base; black for none.

fields.name: g
fields.doc: Asymmetry of that medium's scattering.

fields.name: max_depth
fields.doc: Most bounces followed between the layers.

fields.name: samples
fields.doc: Random walks averaged per evaluation.

coated_conductor.label: Coated conductor
coated_conductor.doc: A metal under a clear dielectric coat (pbrt's layered material): lacquered or car-paint metal.

fields.name: metal
fields.doc: A measured metal: silver, aluminium, gold, copper or brass.

fields.name: eta
fields.doc: Without metal: refractive index per channel (with k; default white if only k is given).

fields.name: k
fields.doc: Without metal: absorption index per channel (default black if only eta is given).

fields.name: reflectance
fields.doc: Without metal, eta or k: the colour reflected at normal incidence.

fields.name: conductor_roughness
fields.doc: Roughness of the metal under the coat.

fields.name: roughness
fields.doc: Roughness of the coat.

fields.name: refractive_index
fields.doc: Index of the coat.

fields.name: thickness
fields.doc: Thickness of the layer between coat and base; must be positive.

fields.name: medium_albedo
fields.doc: Albedo of a scattering medium between coat and base; black for none.

fields.name: g
fields.doc: Asymmetry of that medium's scattering.

fields.name: max_depth
fields.doc: Most bounces followed between the layers.

fields.name: samples
fields.doc: Random walks averaged per evaluation.

subsurface.label: Subsurface
subsurface.doc: Random-walk subsurface scattering under a dielectric surface: skin, wax, marble, milk.

fields.name: albedo
fields.doc: Colour of the light that comes back out.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: How far light travels inside, scene units: a number or a colour (per channel).

fields.name: sigma_a
fields.doc: In place of albedo and radius: absorption coefficient, per scene unit.

fields.name: sigma_s
fields.doc: In place of albedo and radius: scattering coefficient, per scene unit.

fields.name: g
fields.doc: Asymmetry of the scattering inside, -1 to 1 exclusive.

fields.name: refractive_index
fields.doc: Index of the surface.

hair.label: Hair
hair.doc: pbrt's hair BSDF, for cylinder curves (curves, fur): coloured by melanin, a colour or an absorption.

fields.name: eumelanin
fields.doc: Concentration of the dark pigment (0.3 blonde, 1.3 brown, 8 black).

fields.name: pheomelanin
fields.doc: Concentration of the red pigment.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: In place of the melanins: the hair's colour.

fields.name: sigma_a
fields.doc: In place of those: absorption inside the hair (takes precedence).

fields.name: eta
fields.doc: Refractive index of the hair.

fields.name: beta_m
fields.doc: Roughness along the hair.

fields.name: beta_n
fields.doc: Roughness around the hair.

fields.name: alpha
fields.doc: Tilt of the hair's scales, degrees.

rough_dielectric.label: Rough dielectric
rough_dielectric.doc: Frosted glass: a dielectric with a GGX microfacet surface.

fields.name: refractive_index
fields.doc: Index of refraction. A number, a glass name (BK7, fused silica, SF11, diamond), {"cauchy": [a, b]} or {"sellmeier": {"b": [..], "c": [..]}}; these disperse in spectral mode.

fields.name: roughness
fields.doc: GGX roughness of the surface.

fields.name: attenuate
fields.doc: Tint applied to light passing through or reflected.

thin_dielectric.label: Thin dielectric
thin_dielectric.doc: A pane of glass of no thickness: it reflects and transmits without bending light.

fields.name: refractive_index
fields.doc: Index of refraction. A number, a glass name (BK7, fused silica, SF11, diamond), {"cauchy": [a, b]} or {"sellmeier": {"b": [..], "c": [..]}}; these disperse in spectral mode.

uv.label: UV
uv.doc: Shows the surface's texture coordinates as colour, for checking them.

checker.label: Checker
checker.doc: A diffuse checkerboard in the surface's texture coordinates.

fields.name: colors
fields.doc: The two colours, [colour, colour].

fields.name: checks
fields.doc: Checks across the texture: a number, or [u, v].

soil.label: Soil
soil.doc: Procedural bare ground: mottled earth with stones, crumbs, plant litter and moss, bump mapped.

fields.name: preset
fields.doc: Kind of ground; every style field below defaults from it.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Main colour of the earth (default from the preset; loam's shown).

fields.name: humus
fields.doc: Darker colour it mottles toward (default from the preset; loam's shown).

fields.name: mottle_size
fields.doc: Size of the mottling, m (default from the preset; loam's shown).

fields.name: stone_color
fields.doc: Colour of the stones (default from the preset; loam's shown).

fields.name: stones
fields.doc: Fraction of the ground covered by stones (default from the preset; loam's shown).

fields.name: stone_size
fields.doc: Size of the stones, m (default from the preset; loam's shown).

fields.name: crumb_color
fields.doc: Colour of the crumbs of earth (default from the preset; loam's shown).

fields.name: crumbs
fields.doc: Fraction covered by crumbs (default from the preset; loam's shown).

fields.name: litter_color
fields.doc: Colour of dead plant litter (default from the preset; loam's shown).

fields.name: litter
fields.doc: Fraction covered by litter (default from the preset; loam's shown).

fields.name: litter_length
fields.doc: Length of a piece of litter, m (default from the preset; loam's shown).

fields.name: litter_width
fields.doc: Width of a piece of litter, m (default from the preset; loam's shown).

fields.name: moss_color
fields.doc: Colour of the moss (default from the preset; loam's shown).

fields.name: moss
fields.doc: Fraction covered by moss (default from the preset; loam's shown).

fields.name: bump
fields.doc: Strength of the relief (default from the preset; loam's shown).

fields.name: clod_size
fields.doc: Size of the clods, m (default from the preset; loam's shown).

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Scene units per metre of the texture (for a scene not in metres).

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Chooses the pattern.

fields.name: wetness
fields.doc: Darker and glossier.

mix.label: Mix
mix.doc: Two materials mixed: at each point the second with probability amount, else the first.

fields.name: materials
fields.doc: Names of the two materials, [A, B].

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: Share of B, 0 to 1; or a texture object whose grey level is the share: an image {"texture": file, ...}, {"slope": [from, to]}, {"height": [from, to]} or {"terrain": ...}.

fields.name: material
fields.doc: The material.

checkered-y-plane.label: Checkered
checkered-y-plane.doc: Two materials in a chequerboard over the xz plane.

fields.name: m1
fields.doc: Material of one set of squares.

fields.name: m2
fields.doc: Material of the other.

fields.name: xsize
fields.doc: Size of a square along x.

fields.name: zsize
fields.doc: Size of a square along z.

noise.label: Noise texture
noise.doc: A base material with its colour varied by procedural noise (the same as the noise material).

fields.name: base_material
fields.doc: Material whose colour is varied; absent (or unknown): white lambertian.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Colour blended in by the noise (also a name: black, white, red, green, blue).

fields.name: blend_factor
fields.doc: How strongly the noise colour is blended in, 0 to 1.

fields.name: noise_type
fields.doc: Kind of noise (anything unrecognised is perlin).

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Frequency of the pattern: the point is multiplied by this.

fields.name: octaves
fields.doc: fbm and turbulence: layers of detail.

fields.name: persistence
fields.doc: fbm: amplitude of each octave relative to the last.

fields.name: lacunarity
fields.doc: fbm: frequency of each octave relative to the last.

fields.name: point_density
fields.doc: worley: feature points per unit cell.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Seeds the pattern; absent: Perlin's reference table (and Worley seed 42).

noise_medium.label: Noise mix
noise_medium.doc: Two materials, chosen at each point by whether procedural noise is above a threshold.

fields.name: m1
fields.doc: Material where the noise is below the threshold.

fields.name: m2
fields.doc: Material where it is above.

fields.name: threshold
fields.doc: Noise level (0 to 1) dividing the two.

fields.name: noise_type
fields.doc: Kind of noise (anything unrecognised is perlin).

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Frequency of the pattern: the point is multiplied by this.

fields.name: octaves
fields.doc: fbm and turbulence: layers of detail.

fields.name: persistence
fields.doc: fbm: amplitude of each octave relative to the last.

fields.name: lacunarity
fields.doc: fbm: frequency of each octave relative to the last.

fields.name: point_density
fields.doc: worley: feature points per unit cell.
